items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was working in your group

ctx.x: OK, well I’m glad we cleared that up, but I do have a quote from Woody Shaw saying that there was a lack of work at this time because he was working in your group and I guess he said jokingly that they called your band the “starvation band.” I guess times were pretty hard at that point?
